task007.scenario: Your scout leader asked pupils to email about a camping trip. Write an email to your scout leader about camping and helping the environment.

modelAnswer.subject: My Camping Trip
modelAnswer.body: I packed a torch for camping. I saw a squirrel collecting nuts near our tent. After breakfast, we put glass bottles and metal cans into the recycling bin. It was fun helping!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya mengemas lampu suluh untuk berkhemah. Saya nampak seekor tupai mengumpul kacang berhampiran khemah kami. Selepas sarapan, kami memasukkan botol kaca dan tin logam ke dalam tong kitar semula. Seronok dapat membantu!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我打包了一支手电筒去露营。我看见一只松鼠在我们的帐篷附近收集坚果。早餐后，我们把玻璃瓶和金属罐放进回收箱。能帮上忙真开心！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku ngemas lampu suluh alai bekhemah. Aku meda seekur tupai ngumpul kachang semak khemah kami. Udah pengabang pagi, kami ngengkahka butul kaca enggau tin besi dalam tong kitar baru. Nyamai bela nulung!

meaning.en: a black-and-white bear that eats bamboo
an animal that only eats plants
an animal that only eats meat
a tall bird with long legs that cannot fly
a tall, hollow plant that pandas eat
to feed on bamboo
to move very quickly
a bird with a long body or neck

sentences.text: A panda is a herbivore that eats bamboo.

translation.ms: Panda ialah herbivor yang makan buluh.
translation.zh: 熊猫是一种吃竹子的食草动物。
translation.iba: Panda nya herbivor ti makai buluh.

sentences.text: An ostrich is a tall bird that cannot fly.

translation.ms: Burung unta ialah burung tinggi yang tidak boleh terbang.
translation.zh: 鸵鸟是一种不会飞的高大鸟类。
translation.iba: Burung unta nya burung tinggi ti enda ulih terbai.

task008.scenario: Your science club is doing an animal project. Write an email to your club leader about an amazing animal.

modelAnswer.subject: My Animal Project
modelAnswer.body: For my project, I chose the panda. A panda is a herbivore, so it eats plants like bamboo. One fact is that pandas eat for twelve hours a day! Pandas are amazing.

bodyTranslation.ms: Untuk projek saya, saya memilih panda. Panda ialah haiwan herbivor, jadi ia makan tumbuhan seperti buluh. Satu fakta ialah panda makan selama dua belas jam sehari! Panda sangat menakjubkan.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我的项目选择了熊猫。熊猫是食草动物，所以它吃竹子之类的植物。有一个事实是，熊猫每天要吃十二个小时！熊猫真是太神奇了。
bodyTranslation.iba: Ke projek aku, aku milih panda. Panda nya jelu ke makai buah kayu, nya alai iya makai baka buluh. Siti fakta iya nya panda makai dua belas jam sehari! Panda manah amat.

meaning.en: a competition to see who is fastest
a sport played with a racket and shuttlecock
to push yourself off the ground into the air
feeling worried before doing something
to join a race
to come first in the high jump event
to have a game of badminton

sentences.text: I took part in the high jump this year.

translation.ms: Saya menyertai acara lompat tinggi tahun ini.
translation.zh: 我今年参加了跳高比赛。
translation.iba: Aku nitihka lompat tinggi taun tu.

sentences.text: My best friend cheered for me during the race.

translation.ms: Kawan baik saya bersorak untuk saya semasa perlumbaan itu.
translation.zh: 我最好的朋友在比赛中为我加油。
translation.iba: Kawan rapat aku nyorak ke aku maya perlumba nya.

task009.scenario: Your PE teacher wants to know about your favourite sports day event. Write an email to your PE teacher.
bullets: which sport you took part in
how you felt during the event

modelAnswer.subject: Sports Day
modelAnswer.body: On Sports Day, I took part in the high jump and the race. I felt nervous, but excited when I jumped over the bar. I want to thank my friends for cheering!

bodyTranslation.ms: Pada Hari Sukan, saya menyertai acara lompat tinggi dan perlumbaan. Saya berasa gementar, tetapi teruja apabila saya melompat melepasi palang. Saya ingin berterima kasih kepada kawan-kawan saya kerana menyokong saya!
bodyTranslation.zh: 在运动会那天，我参加了跳高和赛跑项目。我感到紧张，但当我跳过横杆时又很兴奋。我要谢谢我的朋友们为我加油！
bodyTranslation.iba: Lebuh Hari Sukan, aku milu lumpat tinggi enggau balap. Aku rasa takut, tang gaga lebuh aku nyerang palang nya. Aku deka meri terima kasih ngagai pangan aku ke udah nyukung aku!

meaning.en: a pain in the ear
something taken to treat an illness
tiny living things that can cause illness
to relax and stop being active
to feel pain in your ear
to clean germs off with water and soap
to have medicine to treat illness

sentences.text: I had a bad earache yesterday.

translation.ms: Saya mengalami sakit telinga yang teruk semalam.
translation.zh: 我昨天耳朵很痛。
translation.iba: Aku sakit pending balat kemari.

sentences.text: I washed my hands to get rid of germs.

translation.ms: Saya membasuh tangan saya untuk menghilangkan kuman.
translation.zh: 我洗手是为了去除细菌。
translation.iba: Aku ngebasu jari kena muai kuman.

task010.scenario: You stayed home from school feeling unwell. Write an email to your teacher explaining what happened.
bullets: what you did to feel better
when you will return to school

modelAnswer.subject: Feeling Unwell
modelAnswer.body: I could not come to school today because I had a bad earache. My mother gave me medicine, and I rested. I washed my hands to remove germs. I will return tomorrow.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya tidak dapat hadir ke sekolah hari ini kerana telinga saya sakit teruk. Ibu saya memberi saya ubat, dan saya berehat. Saya membasuh tangan saya untuk menghilangkan kuman. Saya akan kembali esok.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我今天不能上学，因为我的耳朵很痛。妈妈给我吃了药，我也休息了。我洗了手以清除细菌。我明天会回学校。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku enda tau datai ngagai sekula tu laban pending aku merinsa amat. Indai aku meri aku ubat, lalu aku ngasuh diri betikai. Aku masu jari alai muai jelu bakteria. Aku deka pulai pagila.

meaning.en: riding a skateboard for fun
the hobby of taking photos
a device used to take photos
to keep steady without falling
to change direction while moving
to ride a skateboard
to use a camera to capture images
to talk to friends using the internet

sentences.text: I go skateboarding at the park every Saturday.

translation.ms: Saya pergi meluncur papan di taman setiap hari Sabtu.
translation.zh: 我每个星期六都去公园玩滑板。
translation.iba: Aku mai bermain papan luncur di taman genap hari Sabtu.

sentences.text: My sister taught me photography last year.

translation.ms: Kakak saya mengajar saya fotografi tahun lepas.
translation.zh: 我姐姐去年教我摄影。
translation.iba: Menyadi indu aku ngajar aku fotografi taun ti udah.

task011.scenario: Your school magazine is collecting pupils' hobbies for the "Fun Time" column. Write an email to the magazine editor about your hobby.
bullets: why other pupils should try it

modelAnswer.subject: My Hobby: Skateboarding
modelAnswer.body: My hobby is skateboarding. My cousin taught me how to balance and turn last summer, and I practise at the park every weekend. Other pupils should try it because it is exciting and keeps you fit!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hobi saya ialah bermain papan luncur. Sepupu saya mengajar saya cara mengimbangi dan membelok pada musim panas lepas, dan saya berlatih di taman setiap hujung minggu. Murid lain patut mencubanya kerana ia mengujakan dan menjaga kecergasan anda!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我的爱好是玩滑板。去年夏天，我的表哥教我怎么保持平衡和转弯，我每个周末都在公园练习。其他同学也应该试试，因为它既刺激又能保持身体健康！
bodyTranslation.iba: Kesuka aku nya bermain papan luncur. Menyadi aku ngajar aku chara nyaga penyeimbang enggau belok maya panas ke udah, lalu aku belatih ba taman genap hujung minggu. Pelajar bukai patut nyoba nya laban iya ngujaka lalu ngasuh tubuh gerai!

meaning.en: a place where you watch films
a place with many books to read or borrow
a small restaurant that sells drinks and light meals
a place where fresh food and goods are sold
a place where plays and shows are performed

phrases.text: watch a film at the cinema

meaning.en: to see a movie in a cinema
to take books from the library to read
to purchase fruit at the market

sentences.text: We can watch a new film at the cinema.

translation.ms: Kita boleh menonton filem baharu di pawagam.
translation.zh: 我们可以在电影院看新电影。
translation.iba: Kitai ulih nonton filem baru di pawagam.

sentences.text: The library has many interesting books to borrow.

translation.ms: Perpustakaan itu mempunyai banyak buku menarik untuk dipinjam.
translation.zh: 图书馆有很多有趣的书可以借。
translation.iba: Pustaka nya bisi mayuh bup ti lucu ulih dipinjam.

task012.scenario: Your relative from another town is visiting. Write an email describing interesting places in your town.
bullets: two places you would visit together

modelAnswer.subject: Places to Visit
modelAnswer.body: I am excited for your visit! We can go to the cinema to watch a new film, then visit the market for fresh fruit. The library is lovely for a quiet afternoon too. See you soon!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya teruja dengan lawatan awak! Kita boleh pergi ke panggung wayang untuk menonton filem baharu, kemudian melawat pasar untuk membeli buah-buahan segar. Perpustakaan juga sesuai untuk petang yang tenang. Jumpa awak tidak lama lagi!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我很期待你的到访！我们可以去电影院看一部新电影，然后去市场买新鲜水果。图书馆也很适合一个安静的下午。很快就能见到你了！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku gaga amat ngintu pengabang nuan! Kitai ulih mansang ngagai panggung wayang meda filem baru, udah nya napang ngagai pasar meli buah baru. Perpustakaan mega manah ke kelemari hari ti sunyi. Betemu enggau nuan pagila!

meaning.en: a public procession of people, often celebrating something
bright, colourful explosions in the night sky
a group of musicians who play together
a special day or period of public celebration
a large group of people gathered together
to look at a parade passing by
to set off fireworks
a group of musicians who play while walking

sentences.text: We watched a colourful parade through the town.

translation.ms: Kami menonton perarakan yang berwarna-warni melalui bandar.
translation.zh: 我们观看了穿过小镇的彩色游行。
translation.iba: Kami nonton perarakan ti berwarna-warni nengah pekan.

sentences.text: The fireworks lit up the whole sky.

translation.ms: Bunga api menerangi seluruh langit.
translation.zh: 烟花照亮了整个天空。
translation.iba: Bunga api nerangka semua langit.

task013.scenario: Your town held a special festival. Write an email to your pen pal describing the event.

modelAnswer.subject: Our Town Festival
modelAnswer.body: Last weekend, our town held a festival with a big parade. I saw dancers, a marching band, and colourful costumes. At night, fireworks lit up the sky above the river. I felt excited and proud of my town!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hujung minggu lepas, bandar kami mengadakan perayaan dengan perarakan besar. Saya nampak penari, kumpulan muzik berbaris, dan kostum berwarna-warni. Pada waktu malam, bunga api menerangi langit di atas sungai. Saya berasa teruja dan bangga dengan bandar saya!
bodyTranslation.zh: 上周末，我们镇上举办了一个有盛大游行的节日。我看到了舞者、军乐队和五颜六色的服装。晚上，烟花照亮了河流上空的天空。我感到很兴奋，也为我的家乡感到骄傲！
bodyTranslation.iba: Hujung minggu ke udah, endur kami ngaga pesta enggau perarakan besai. Aku meda orang nyangkang, kumpulan muzik bejalai, enggau pakaian macha-macha. Lebuh malam, api rami ngasuh terang langit atas sungai. Aku gaga lalu berai ke endur aku!

meaning.en: a huge grey animal with a long trunk
a tall animal with a very long neck
a large, strong ape that lives in forests
a sea animal with eight arms
a large reptile that lives in rivers
to stretch up to get leaves
to move through water below the surface
to stay on the surface of the water

sentences.text: The giraffe used its long neck to reach the leaves.

translation.ms: Zirafah itu menggunakan lehernya yang panjang untuk mencapai daun.
translation.zh: 长颈鹿用它的长脖子够到树叶。
translation.iba: Zirafah ngena tekuluk ti panjai kena nyapai dun.

sentences.text: An octopus can swim quickly underwater.

translation.ms: Seekor sotong kurita boleh berenang dengan pantas di dalam air.
translation.zh: 章鱼可以在水下快速游动。
translation.iba: Sotong kurita ulih berenang enggau pantas dalam ai.

task014.scenario: Your class visited a wildlife park. Write an email to your grandmother about the animals you saw.

modelAnswer.subject: Our Wildlife Park Trip
modelAnswer.body: Yesterday my class visited a wildlife park. I saw a giraffe stretching its neck to reach leaves, and a gorilla resting. The most interesting animal was the octopus, which can change colour underwater. I liked the giraffe best!

bodyTranslation.ms: Semalam, kelas saya melawat taman hidupan liar. Saya nampak zirafah meregangkan lehernya untuk mencapai daun, dan seekor gorila sedang berehat. Haiwan yang paling menarik ialah sotong kurita, yang boleh menukar warna di bawah air. Saya paling suka zirafah!
bodyTranslation.zh: 昨天，我们班参观了一个野生动物公园。我看到长颈鹿伸长脖子去够树叶，还有一只大猩猩在休息。最有趣的动物是章鱼，它能在水下变色。我最喜欢长颈鹿！
bodyTranslation.iba: Kemari, kelas aku napang ngagai taman jelu babas. Aku meda zirafah ngunjur tekuluk iya alai ngambi daun, enggau gorila betikai. Jelu ti pemadu nyamai nya octopus, ke ulih ngubah warna dalam ai. Aku pemadu rinduka zirafah!

meaning.en: a white board written on with markers
a tool used to cut paper
a cover used to keep papers together
a room where lessons take place
to use markers to write on the whiteboard
to use scissors to cut paper
to store papers neatly in a folder

sentences.text: Our teacher writes notes on the whiteboard.

translation.ms: Guru kami menulis nota di papan putih.
translation.zh: 我们的老师在白板上写笔记。
translation.iba: Guru kami nulis nota ba papan puti.

sentences.text: I keep my worksheets in a blue folder.

translation.ms: Saya menyimpan lembaran kerja saya dalam fail biru.
translation.zh: 我把作业纸放在蓝色文件夹里。
translation.iba: Aku nyimpan lembaran kereja aku dalam fail biru.

task015.scenario: A new pupil is joining your class next week. Write an email to welcome them and describe your classroom.
bullets: a school item you use often
one tip to help them settle in

modelAnswer.subject: Welcome to Our Class!
modelAnswer.body: Welcome to our school! Our classroom has a big whiteboard where our teacher writes notes every day. I keep my worksheets in a folder. My tip is to bring scissors and glue for art class!

bodyTranslation.ms: Selamat datang ke sekolah kami! Bilik darjah kami mempunyai papan putih besar tempat guru kami menulis nota setiap hari. Saya menyimpan lembaran kerja saya dalam fail. Petua saya ialah bawa gunting dan gam untuk kelas seni!
bodyTranslation.zh: 欢迎来到我们学校！我们的教室里有一块大白板，老师每天都在上面写笔记。我把练习卷放在文件夹里。我的小建议是：美术课记得带剪刀和胶水！
bodyTranslation.iba: Selamat datai ngagai sekula kami! Bilik kelas kami bisi papan putih besai alai cikgu kami nulis nota genap hari. Aku ngintu leka pengawa aku dalam fail. Pesan aku, bai gunting enggau gam ke kelas seni!

meaning.en: bread with filling between two slices
a warm liquid food often with vegetables
small white or brown grains, a staple food
a food made from milk
a bird often eaten as food
a serving of soup
a sandwich filled with cheese
chicken cooked in an oven, served with rice

sentences.text: A warm bowl of soup is good on a rainy day.

translation.ms: Semangkuk sup panas adalah baik pada hari hujan.
translation.zh: 在下雨天喝一碗热汤很好。
translation.iba: Semangkuk sup ti angat manah ba hari ujan.

sentences.text: Rice and chicken make a filling meal.

translation.ms: Nasi dan ayam menjadikan hidangan yang mengenyangkan.
translation.zh: 米饭和鸡肉是一顿丰盛的饭。
translation.iba: Asi enggau manuk ngaga pemakai ti ngenyangka.

task016.scenario: Your school is planning a healthy food fair. Write an email to the fair organiser suggesting foods to sell.
bullets: a drink to go with them

modelAnswer.subject: Healthy Food Fair Ideas
modelAnswer.body: For the food fair, I suggest selling cheese sandwiches and warm vegetable soup. Both are healthy and quick to eat. Rice and roast chicken would also be filling for older pupils. Fruit juice would go with them!

bodyTranslation.ms: Untuk pesta makanan, saya cadangkan menjual sandwic keju dan sup sayur panas. Kedua-duanya sihat dan cepat dimakan. Nasi dan ayam panggang juga mengenyangkan untuk murid yang lebih tua. Jus buah sesuai dihidangkan bersama!
bodyTranslation.zh: 对于美食节，我建议卖芝士三明治和热腾腾的蔬菜汤。这两样都健康又能很快吃完。米饭配烤鸡对年纪较大的同学来说也很有饱足感。再配上果汁就更好了！
bodyTranslation.iba: Ke pesta pemakai, aku ngasaika kitai jual sandwic keju enggau sup sayur ti angat. Dua iya nya sihat lalu enggat dimakai. Asi enggau manuk panggang mega ngasuh kenyang ke pelajar ke tuai agi. Jus buah manah diminum sama-sama enggau nya!

meaning.en: a sport where players shoot a ball into a hoop
a sport played with rackets over a net
a sport involving balance, flexibility, and strength
a martial art and sport from Japan
a sport played with a stick and a ball
to throw the ball toward the hoop
to train in judo
to move a tennis racket to hit the ball

sentences.text: I practise basketball with my brother every evening.

translation.ms: Saya berlatih bola keranjang dengan abang saya setiap petang.
translation.zh: 我每天晚上都和哥哥练习篮球。
translation.iba: Aku belatih basketball enggau menyadi lelaki aku genap kelemari hari.

sentences.text: Judo has taught me to stay calm and focused.

translation.ms: Judo telah mengajar saya untuk kekal tenang dan fokus.
translation.zh: 柔道教会了我保持冷静和专注。
translation.iba: Judo udah ngajar aku kekal tenang sereta fokus.

task017.scenario: Your PE teacher is choosing pupils for a new sports club. Write an email explaining which sport you would like to join.
bullets: which sport you want to join
why you would be a good member

modelAnswer.subject: Joining the Sports Club
modelAnswer.body: I would like to join the basketball club. I have practised shooting with my brother every evening. I also enjoy judo, which has taught me discipline and focus. I always try my best and encourage my teammates!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya ingin menyertai kelab bola keranjang. Saya telah berlatih menjaringkan bola bersama abang saya setiap petang. Saya juga suka judo, yang telah mengajar saya disiplin dan fokus. Saya sentiasa cuba sedaya upaya dan menyokong rakan sepasukan saya!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我想加入篮球俱乐部。我每天晚上都和哥哥一起练习投篮。我也喜欢柔道，它教会了我纪律和专注力。我总是尽全力，并鼓励我的队友！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku deka nyagi kelab bola keranjang. Aku udah belatih ngena bola enggau menyadi lelaki aku genap kelemari hari. Aku mega rinduka judo, ke udah ngajar aku disiplin enggau fokus. Aku seruran nyoba beguna amat lalu nyukung pangan sepasukan aku!

meaning.en: hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
lenses worn over the eyes to help you see
dark glasses worn to protect eyes from the sun
having a thin body
to respect and like someone very much
to have glasses on your face
to let facial hair grow
to wear sunglasses

sentences.text: My grandfather has a grey beard and wears glasses.

translation.ms: Datuk saya mempunyai janggut kelabu dan memakai cermin mata.
translation.zh: 我爷爷留着灰白的胡须，戴着眼镜。
translation.iba: Aki aku bisi janggut kelabu sereta makai chermin mata.

sentences.text: My aunt is slim and always smiles.

translation.ms: Makcik saya langsing dan sentiasa tersenyum.
translation.zh: 我阿姨很苗条，总是面带微笑。
translation.iba: Ibu sarak aku lanjai sereta seruran tesenyum.

task018.scenario: You are writing a short description of your family for a class "All About Me" book. Write an email to your teacher describing a family member.

modelAnswer.subject: All About My Family
modelAnswer.body: I would like to describe my grandfather. He has a grey beard and wears round glasses when he reads. He is slim and enjoys walking every morning. I admire him because he is patient and kind.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya ingin menceritakan tentang datuk saya. Dia mempunyai janggut kelabu dan memakai cermin mata bulat apabila membaca. Dia kurus dan suka berjalan kaki setiap pagi. Saya mengagumi beliau kerana beliau penyabar dan baik hati.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我想介绍一下我的爷爷。他留着灰白的胡子，看书时会戴上圆眼镜。他身材瘦削，喜欢每天早上散步。我敬佩他，因为他既有耐心又善良。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku deka madahka pasal aki aku. Iya bisi janggut kelabu lalu makai kacamata bulat lebuh iya macha. Iya lansing lalu rinduka bejalai kaki genap pagi. Aku ngasi iya laban iya penyabar lalu manah ati.

meaning.en: a portable shelter made of cloth
a padded bag used for sleeping outdoors
a case used to carry clothes when travelling
lotion that protects skin from the sun
covered with thick mist
to put things into a suitcase for a trip
to apply sun cream to your skin
to rest in a padded outdoor bag

sentences.text: I will pack sun cream in case it is sunny.

translation.ms: Saya akan mengemas krim matahari jika cuaca panas.
translation.zh: 我会带防晒霜，以防天气晴朗。
translation.iba: Aku deka ngemas krim mata hari enti panas.

sentences.text: We will sleep in a tent near the lake.

translation.ms: Kami akan tidur dalam khemah berhampiran tasik.
translation.zh: 我们将在湖边的帐篷里睡觉。
translation.iba: Kami deka tinduk dalam khemah semak tasik.

task019.scenario: Your family is planning a camping holiday. Write an email to your friend about your holiday plans.
bullets: what the weather might be like
what you are looking forward to

modelAnswer.subject: Our Camping Holiday
modelAnswer.body: Next week, my family is going camping by the lake. I will pack a sleeping bag and some sun cream. It might be foggy, so we will bring jackets. I can't wait to sleep in a tent!

bodyTranslation.ms: Minggu depan, keluarga saya akan pergi berkhemah di tepi tasik. Saya akan mengemas beg tidur dan sedikit krim pelindung matahari. Mungkin akan berkabus, jadi kami akan membawa jaket. Saya tidak sabar untuk tidur dalam khemah!
bodyTranslation.zh: 下星期，我一家人要去湖边露营。我会打包睡袋和一些防晒霜。天气可能会有雾，所以我们会带外套。我等不及要在帐篷里睡觉了！
bodyTranslation.iba: Minggu ila, keluarga aku deka bekhemah semak danau. Aku deka ngemas beg tinduk enggau krim ngelama mata hari. Kandang bekabus, nya alai kami deka bai jaket. Aku enda sabar deka tinduk dalam khemah!

meaning.en: a loud sound that warns of danger

a vehicle that carries firefighters and equipment
a scientific test to find something out
not worried or excited; peaceful
to activate the alarm
to leave without rushing or panicking
an alarm with a loud sound

sentences.text: The fire alarm rang loudly during class.

translation.ms: Penggera kebakaran berbunyi kuat semasa kelas.
translation.zh: 火警警报在上课时响亮地响起。
translation.iba: Alarm kebakaran bebunyi inggar maya kelas.

sentences.text: We walked outside calmly during the fire drill.

translation.ms: Kami berjalan keluar dengan tenang semasa latihan kebakaran.
translation.zh: 我们在消防演习期间冷静地走到外面。
translation.iba: Kami bejalai pansut enggau tenang maya latihan kebakaran.

task020.scenario: There was a fire drill at your school. Write an email to your cousin describing what happened.
bullets: what you learned about fire safety

modelAnswer.subject: Our Fire Drill
modelAnswer.body: This morning, our school had a fire drill. The alarm rang loudly during our science lesson, and everyone stopped what they were doing. We walked outside calmly in a line. A fire engine arrived to check on us! I learned that staying calm is important during an emergency.

bodyTranslation.ms: Pagi ini, sekolah kami mengadakan latihan kebakaran. Penggera berbunyi kuat semasa waktu pelajaran sains kami, dan semua orang berhenti daripada apa yang sedang dilakukan. Kami berjalan keluar dengan tenang dalam satu barisan. Sebuah enjin bomba tiba untuk memeriksa kami! Saya belajar bahawa kekal tenang adalah penting semasa kecemasan.
bodyTranslation.zh: 今天早上，我们学校进行了消防演习。警报器在我们上科学课时大声响起，大家都停下了手上的事情。我们排成一列，冷静地走到室外。一辆消防车到达检查我们的情况！我学到了在紧急情况下保持冷静非常重要。
bodyTranslation.iba: Pagi tu, sekula kami ngaga latihan api. Alarm nyawa inggar maya pelajar sains kami, lalu semua orang badu ngereja pengawa sida. Kami bejalai pansa enggau tenang dalam siti barisan. Siti enjin api datai meriksa kami! Aku belajar tetap tenang beguna amat maya kecemasan.

sentences.text: People used an oil lamp for light before electricity.

translation.ms: Orang menggunakan pelita minyak untuk cahaya sebelum elektrik ada.
translation.zh: 在电力出现之前，人们使用油灯照明。
translation.iba: Orang mayuh ngena pelita minyak ke penerang sebedau elektrik bisi.

translation.zh: 考古学家小心地挖掘以寻找古物。

task021.scenario: Your class visited a history museum. Write an email to your teacher about what you saw.
bullets: how it was different from today

modelAnswer.subject: Our Museum Visit
modelAnswer.body: Yesterday, our class visited the history museum. I saw an old oil lamp that people used for light before electricity. There was also a painted portrait of a soldier from long ago. I found it interesting that archaeologists still dig to find objects like these.

bodyTranslation.ms: Semalam, kelas kami melawat muzium sejarah. Saya melihat lampu minyak lama yang digunakan orang untuk cahaya sebelum adanya elektrik. Terdapat juga sebuah potret berlukis seorang askar dari zaman dahulu. Saya rasa menarik bahawa ahli arkeologi masih menggali untuk mencari objek seperti ini.
bodyTranslation.zh: 昨天，我们班参观了历史博物馆。我看到一盏旧油灯，那是人们在有电之前用来照明的。那里还有一幅很久以前一位士兵的画像。我觉得很有趣的是，考古学家至今仍在挖掘寻找这样的文物。
bodyTranslation.iba: Kemari, kelas kami napang ngagai muzium sejarah. Aku meda lampu minyak lama ke digunaka orang alai penerang sebedau bisi elektrik. Bisi mega gambar dilukis seiku soldadu ari maya lama. Aku rasa nyamai ahli arkeologi agi ngali ngambi utai baka tu.

translation.zh: 我打包了指南针和急救箱。
translation.iba: Aku ngemas kompas enggau kit pertulung awal.

sentences.text: We felt like real explorers on the trail.

translation.ms: Kami berasa seperti peneroka sebenar di laluan itu.
translation.zh: 我们在小径上感觉自己像真正的探险家。
translation.iba: Kami rasa baka peneroka sebenar ba jalai nya.

task022.scenario: You went hiking with your family last weekend. Write an email to your friend about the adventure.
bullets: what you saw along the way
how you felt at the end

modelAnswer.subject: Our Weekend Hike
modelAnswer.body: Last weekend, my family went hiking in the hills. I packed a rucksack with a compass, a torch, and a first aid kit. Along the way, we saw a waterfall and a family of monkeys in the trees. By the end, we felt tired but proud explorers!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hujung minggu lepas, keluarga saya pergi mendaki bukit. Saya mengemas beg galas dengan kompas, lampu suluh, dan kit pertolongan cemas. Sepanjang perjalanan, kami nampak air terjun dan sekumpulan keluarga monyet di atas pokok. Pada akhirnya, kami berasa penat tetapi bangga menjadi peneroka!
bodyTranslation.zh: 上周末，我们一家人去山上远足。我在背包里装了指南针、手电筒和急救包。一路上，我们看到了瀑布，还有一家住在树上的猴子。到最后，我们感到很累，但作为探险者感到很自豪！
bodyTranslation.iba: Hujung minggu ke udah, keluarga aku mansang ngundan bukit. Aku ngemas beg galas enggau kompas, lampu suluh, enggau kit pertolong. Sepemanjai jalai, kami meda ai terejun enggau keluarga monyet ba kayu. Ba pengujung, kami lelak tang berai nyadi penerokai!

translation.zh: 园丁修剪树篱并给植物浇水。
translation.iba: Tukang kebun mangkas pagar dun sereta nyiram tanaman.

translation.zh: 她成为老师之前在大学学习过。
translation.iba: Iya belajar di universiti sebedau nyadi guru.

task023.scenario: Your school held a Careers Day. Write an email to your parent about a job you found interesting.
bullets: whether you would like that job

modelAnswer.subject: Careers Day at School
modelAnswer.body: Today was Careers Day at school, and I learned about many jobs. I found the gardener's job most interesting because she trims hedges and grows flowers around the school. She studied at university first. I would like to be a gardener too, because I enjoy being outdoors!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hari ini ialah Hari Kerjaya di sekolah, dan saya belajar tentang pelbagai pekerjaan. Saya rasa kerja tukang kebun paling menarik kerana dia mencantas pagar hidup dan menanam bunga di sekeliling sekolah. Dia belajar di universiti terlebih dahulu. Saya juga ingin menjadi tukang kebun, kerana saya suka berada di luar!
bodyTranslation.zh: 今天是学校的职业日，我了解了很多不同的职业。我觉得园丁的工作最有趣，因为她要修剪树篱，还要在学校周围种花。她先在大学读过书。我也想当园丁，因为我喜欢待在户外！
bodyTranslation.iba: Tu hari Hari Pengawa ba sekula, lalu aku belajar pasal mayuh pengawa. Aku rasa pengawa tukang kebun pemadu nyamai laban iya nyendi pagar enggau nanam bungai bekeliling sekula. Iya belajar ba universiti dulu. Aku deka mega nyadi tukang kebun, laban aku rinduka diau di luar!

sentences.text: The morning bus is always very crowded.

translation.iba: Aku rinduka bebasikal di laluan basikal.

task024.scenario: Your teacher is doing a class survey about transport. Write an email describing how you travel and a problem you noticed.

modelAnswer.subject: Getting Around My Town
modelAnswer.body: I usually travel to school by bus, but it is often very crowded in the morning. Sometimes I ride my bicycle along the cycle path, which is faster. I think the school could ask for more buses at busy times to make travelling easier.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya biasanya pergi ke sekolah dengan bas, tetapi selalunya sangat sesak pada waktu pagi. Kadangkala saya menunggang basikal di sepanjang laluan basikal, yang lebih cepat. Saya rasa sekolah boleh memohon lebih banyak bas pada waktu sibuk untuk memudahkan perjalanan.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我通常坐巴士上学，但早上经常非常拥挤。有时候我会沿着自行车道骑自行车，这样更快。我觉得学校可以在高峰时段申请更多巴士，让出行更方便。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku selalu bejalai ngagai sekula ngena bas, tang seruran rami ba pagi. Kadang-kadang aku nunggang basikal ba jalai basikal, ke enggat agi. Aku berunding sekula ulih minta bas ti mayuh agi maya rami ngambika bejalai senang agi.

task025.scenario: Your class did a recycling craft project. Write an email to your art teacher about what you made.
bullets: what you would like to make next

modelAnswer.subject: My Recycling Craft
modelAnswer.body: For our craft project, I used an old plastic bottle and some denim fabric. I cut and glued the pieces to make a pencil holder for my desk. It took patience, but I am proud of it. Next time, I want to try wood!

bodyTranslation.ms: Untuk projek kraf kami, saya menggunakan botol plastik lama dan sedikit kain denim. Saya memotong dan menggam kepingan-kepingan itu untuk membuat tempat pensel di atas meja saya. Ia memerlukan kesabaran, tetapi saya berbangga dengannya. Lain kali, saya mahu mencuba kayu!
bodyTranslation.zh: 在我们的手工项目中，我用了一个旧塑料瓶和一些牛仔布。我剪裁并粘合这些材料，做成了一个放在书桌上的笔筒。这需要耐心，但我很为它感到骄傲。下次，我想试试用木头做！
bodyTranslation.iba: Ke projek kraf kami, aku ngena butul plastik lama enggau kain denim. Aku motong lalu ngam keping-keping nya alai ngaga endur pensel ba mija aku. Nya minta penyabar, tang aku berai ke nya. Lain kali, aku deka nyoba kayu!

task026.scenario: Your school music club president wants an email about the music you listen to. Write an email describing your taste in music.

modelAnswer.subject: My Favourite Music
modelAnswer.body: My favourite type of music is pop music because the songs are catchy and fun to sing along to. I usually listen to it in the morning. Sometimes at night, I listen to classical music because it helps me feel calm. Music always makes my day better!

bodyTranslation.ms: Jenis muzik kegemaran saya ialah muzik pop kerana lagunya mudah diingat dan seronok dinyanyikan bersama. Saya biasanya mendengarnya pada waktu pagi. Kadangkala pada waktu malam, saya mendengar muzik klasik kerana ia membantu saya berasa tenang. Muzik sentiasa menjadikan hari saya lebih baik!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我最喜欢的音乐类型是流行音乐，因为歌曲朗朗上口，跟着唱很有趣。我通常在早上听流行音乐。有时候晚上，我会听古典音乐，因为它能让我感到平静。音乐总能让我的一天变得更好！
bodyTranslation.iba: Jenis muzik ti pemadu dikerinduka aku nya muzik pop laban lagu iya mit dikelala lalu nyamai dinyanyika sama. Aku selalu ninga iya ba pagi. Kadang-kadang ba malam, aku ninga muzik klasik laban iya nulung aku rasa tenang. Muzik seruran ngasuh hari aku manah agi!

task027.scenario: You are reviewing your favourite storybook for the class reading corner. Write an email to the librarian about the story.
bullets: the exciting part of the story

modelAnswer.subject: My Favourite Storybook
modelAnswer.body: My favourite storybook is about a brave girl who rescues her friend after he is tied up with rope by a trickster. A graceful swan helps guide them home through the forest. The story taught me that true friends always help each other, no matter the danger.

bodyTranslation.ms: Buku cerita kegemaran saya bercerita tentang seorang gadis berani yang menyelamatkan kawannya selepas dia diikat dengan tali oleh seorang penipu. Seekor angsa yang anggun membantu memandu mereka pulang melalui hutan. Kisah itu mengajar saya bahawa kawan sejati sentiasa membantu satu sama lain, tidak kira apa bahaya sekalipun.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我最喜欢的故事书讲的是一个勇敢的女孩，她的朋友被一个骗子用绳子绑了起来，她把他救了出来。一只优雅的天鹅帮助他们穿过森林找到回家的路。这个故事教会我，真正的朋友无论遇到什么危险都会互相帮助。
bodyTranslation.iba: Buku cherita ti pemadu dikerinduka aku pasal siti anak indu ke berani ngelaboh pangan iya udah iya diikat tali penipu. Angsa ti manah tulung nunjuk sida pulai ngagai rumah nengah babas. Cherita nya ngajar aku pangan ti bendar seruran nulung pangan diri, nadai kira baya nama.

task028.scenario: The school council is discussing healthy lifestyles. Write an email to the council chairperson sharing your opinion.
bullets: do you think pupils eat too many sweets and snacks
one suggestion for a healthier lifestyle

modelAnswer.subject: Healthy Lifestyle Opinion
modelAnswer.body: I think many pupils eat too many sweets and snacks, especially before an exam. This is because sweets are sold cheaply near the school gate. I believe a healthy diet with more fruit would help us focus better. I suggest the canteen sell more fruit and fewer sweets.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya rasa ramai murid makan terlalu banyak gula-gula dan snek, terutamanya sebelum peperiksaan. Ini kerana gula-gula dijual dengan murah berhampiran pintu pagar sekolah. Saya percaya diet sihat dengan lebih banyak buah-buahan akan membantu kita fokus dengan lebih baik. Saya mencadangkan kantin menjual lebih banyak buah dan kurang gula-gula.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我觉得很多同学吃太多糖果和零食了，尤其是考试前。这是因为学校门口附近有便宜的糖果卖。我相信多吃水果的健康饮食能帮助我们更好地集中注意力。我建议食堂多卖水果，少卖糖果。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku berunding mayuh pelajar makai gula-gula enggau snek mayuh amat, kelebih agi sebedau peperiksa. Tu laban gula-gula dijual mirah semak pintu sekula. Aku pechaya pemakai sihat enggau buah mayuh agi tulung kitai fokus manah agi. Aku ngasaika kantin jual buah mayuh agi lalu gula-gula mimit agi.

sentences.text: Someone must have broken into the store room.

translation.zh: 一定有人闯入了储藏室。
translation.iba: Orang tentu udah masuk paksa ka bilik stor nya.

task029.scenario: Something strange happened at school and you are the detective. Write an email to your detective partner about your findings.

modelAnswer.subject: The School Mystery
modelAnswer.body: Something strange happened at school today. The store room window was broken into overnight, and some sports equipment went missing. I found a muddy footprint and a torn cloth on the fence. I think someone borrowed the equipment without asking, then lied about it. Let's investigate!

bodyTranslation.ms: Sesuatu yang pelik berlaku di sekolah hari ini. Tingkap bilik stor telah dipecah masuk pada waktu malam, dan sebahagian peralatan sukan hilang. Saya menjumpai kesan tapak kaki berlumpur dan kain koyak di atas pagar. Saya rasa seseorang meminjam peralatan itu tanpa bertanya, kemudian berbohong mengenainya. Mari kita siasat!
bodyTranslation.zh: 今天学校发生了一件奇怪的事。储藏室的窗户在夜里被人闯入破坏，一些体育器材不见了。我在栅栏上发现了一个泥泞的脚印和一块撕破的布。我觉得是有人没经过允许就借走了器材，然后还撒了谎。我们一起来调查吧！
bodyTranslation.iba: Bisi utai ti pelik nyadi ba sekula tu hari. Jenila bilik stor dipechah maya malam, lalu peralatan main lesap. Aku bertemu tapak kaki bertan enggau kain koyak ba pagar. Aku berunding orang minjam peralatan nya nadai nanya, udah nya bula pasal nya. Aram kitai nyiasat!

translation.zh: 我们每天傍晚给花园里的植物浇水。

task030.scenario: Your penpal asked what your family enjoys doing together on weekends. Write an email to your penpal about a hobby you share with your family.

modelAnswer.subject: My Family Hobby
modelAnswer.body: My family and I enjoy gardening together. My mother taught me to water the plants and grow flowers. We also collect stamps from old letters. I enjoy it because we spend happy time together.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya dan keluarga saya suka berkebun bersama-sama. Ibu saya mengajar saya menyiram tumbuhan dan menanam bunga. Kami juga mengumpul setem daripada surat lama. Saya sukakannya kerana kami menghabiskan masa yang gembira bersama-sama.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我和家人喜欢一起种花种草。妈妈教我给植物浇水和种花。我们也会收集旧信件上的邮票。我很喜欢这样，因为我们能一起共度快乐的时光。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku enggau kaban keluarga aku rinduka bekebun sama-sama. Indai aku ngajar aku nyiram buah kayu enggau nanam bungai. Kami mega ngumpul setem ari surat lama. Aku rinduka nya laban kami bulih maya ti gaga sama-sama.

meaning.en: the subject about things that happened long ago
a chart showing when each lesson happens
school work done at home
a place at school where you buy food
a short rest time between lessons
to look at the timetable for lessons
to complete school work at home
to have a meal at the school canteen

sentences.text: I check the timetable every morning before class.

translation.ms: Saya menyemak jadual waktu setiap pagi sebelum kelas.
translation.zh: 我每天早上上课前查看时间表。
translation.iba: Aku meriksa jadual waktu genap pagi sebedau kelas.

sentences.text: We eat fried rice at the canteen during breaktime.

translation.ms: Kami makan nasi goreng di kantin semasa waktu rehat.
translation.zh: 我们课间休息时在食堂吃炒饭。
translation.iba: Kami makai nasi goreng di kantin maya wayah rehat.

task031.scenario: Your cousin is starting Year 4 next year and asked about your school day. Write an email to your cousin about your school subjects and timetable.

modelAnswer.subject: My School Day
modelAnswer.body: My favourite subject is history because the stories are interesting. During breaktime, I eat noodles at the canteen with my friends. I check my timetable so I do not forget my homework. School is fun!

bodyTranslation.ms: Mata pelajaran kegemaran saya ialah sejarah kerana ceritanya menarik. Semasa waktu rehat, saya makan mi di kantin bersama kawan-kawan saya. Saya menyemak jadual waktu supaya tidak lupa kerja rumah saya. Sekolah sangat menyeronokkan!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是历史，因为里面的故事很有趣。下课休息时，我会和朋友们在食堂吃面。我会查看时间表，这样就不会忘记做功课。上学真有趣！
bodyTranslation.iba: Pelajar ti pemadu dikerinduka aku nya sejarah laban leka jaku ke nyamai. Lebuh maya rehat, aku makai mi ba kantin enggau pangan aku. Aku meda jadual jam ngambika aku enda lupa pengawa rumah. Sekula nyamai amat!

meaning.en: a large stone building with a triangle shape
a king of ancient Egypt
a building where old and interesting things are shown
a dead body wrapped in cloth by ancient Egyptians
a public show of interesting objects
to go and see a museum
to construct a pyramid
to view items in an exhibition

sentences.text: We visited the museum to see the Egypt exhibition.

translation.ms: Kami melawat muzium untuk melihat pameran Mesir.
translation.zh: 我们参观了博物馆的埃及展览。
translation.iba: Kami nemuai muzium kena meda pameran Mesir.

sentences.text: The pharaoh was buried inside a huge pyramid.

translation.ms: Firaun itu dikebumikan di dalam piramid yang besar.
translation.zh: 法老被埋葬在一座巨大的金字塔里。
translation.iba: Firaun nya dikubur dalam piramid ti besai.

task032.scenario: Your school library had an Ancient Egypt exhibition. Write an email to your friend about what you saw at the exhibition.
bullets: what you saw at the exhibition

modelAnswer.subject: Ancient Egypt Exhibition
modelAnswer.body: Our library held an Ancient Egypt exhibition. I saw a picture of a huge pyramid and learned that pharaohs were buried inside them with treasure. I saw a mummy wrapped in cloth. I felt amazed!

bodyTranslation.ms: Perpustakaan kami mengadakan pameran Mesir Purba. Saya melihat gambar piramid yang besar dan mengetahui bahawa firaun dikebumikan di dalamnya bersama harta karun. Saya melihat mumia yang dibalut dengan kain. Saya berasa kagum!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我们的图书馆举办了一个古埃及展览。我看到了一张巨大金字塔的照片，还知道法老们连同宝藏一起被葬在里面。我看到了一具用布包裹的木乃伊。我感到非常惊讶！
bodyTranslation.iba: Perpustakaan kami ngaga pameran Mesir Lama. Aku meda gambar piramid ti besai lalu belajar pharaoh dikubur dalam sida nya enggau pengaya. Aku meda mumia ke dibungkus enggau kain. Aku rasa alit amat!

meaning.en: a light carried or hung during a celebration
a large meal for a special celebration
to make a place look nice for a celebration
a present given to someone
to do something special to mark an event
to make the house look nice for a celebration
to turn on or hang a lantern
to hand someone a present

sentences.text: We decorated the house with colourful lanterns.

translation.ms: Kami menghias rumah dengan tanglung berwarna-warni.
translation.zh: 我们用彩色灯笼装饰了房子。
translation.iba: Kami ngias rumah enggau lampu berwarna-warni.

sentences.text: My grandmother cooked a big feast for the family.

translation.ms: Nenek saya memasak jamuan besar untuk keluarga.
translation.zh: 我奶奶为家人做了一顿丰盛的宴席。
translation.iba: Aki aku masak kenduri besai ke kaban.

task033.scenario: Your family celebrated a festival at home. Write an email to your friend about the festival.
bullets: a gift you gave or received

modelAnswer.subject: Our Festival
modelAnswer.body: Last week, my family celebrated a festival at home. We decorated the house with lanterns and lights. My grandmother cooked a big feast with my favourite dishes. I also gave my sister a small gift.

bodyTranslation.ms: Minggu lepas, keluarga saya meraikan sebuah perayaan di rumah. Kami menghiasi rumah dengan tanglung dan lampu. Nenek saya memasak jamuan besar dengan hidangan kegemaran saya. Saya juga memberi hadiah kecil kepada adik perempuan saya.
bodyTranslation.zh: 上周，我的家人在家里庆祝了一个节日。我们用灯笼和彩灯装饰了房子。奶奶煮了一顿丰盛的大餐，里面有我最喜欢的菜。我也送了一份小礼物给我妹妹。
bodyTranslation.iba: Minggu ke udah, keluarga aku ngintu pesta di rumah. Kami ngiaska rumah enggau lanterna enggau lampu. Nenek aku nyapa pengawa makai besai enggau pemakai ti pemadu dikerinduka aku. Aku mega meri menyadi indu aku pemeri mit.

meaning.en: a soft food made by boiling oats or rice in milk or water
a plant food like carrot or cabbage
the first meal of the day
good for the body, full of nutrients
a white drink from cows, good for health
to have vegetables as food
to have a glass of milk
to eat porridge in the morning

sentences.text: I have porridge and milk for breakfast every day.

translation.ms: Saya makan bubur dan minum susu untuk sarapan setiap hari.
translation.zh: 我每天早餐都吃粥喝牛奶。
translation.iba: Aku makai bubur enggau ngirup susu genap pagi hari.

sentences.text: Vegetables are nutritious and good for our bodies.

translation.ms: Sayur berkhasiat dan baik untuk tubuh kita.
translation.zh: 蔬菜有营养，对我们的身体有好处。
translation.iba: Sayur beguna ke tubuh kitai.

task034.scenario: Your friend asked what you eat for breakfast. Write an email to your friend about your breakfast and healthy food.
bullets: what you usually eat for breakfast

modelAnswer.subject: My Healthy Breakfast
modelAnswer.body: Every morning, I eat porridge and drink a glass of milk. I also like eating vegetables because they are nutritious. Breakfast is important because it gives me energy for school. What do you eat?

bodyTranslation.ms: Setiap pagi, saya makan bubur dan minum segelas susu. Saya juga suka makan sayur-sayuran kerana ia berkhasiat. Sarapan penting kerana ia memberi saya tenaga untuk ke sekolah. Apa yang awak makan?
bodyTranslation.zh: 每天早上，我都吃粥并喝一杯牛奶。我也喜欢吃蔬菜，因为它们很有营养。早餐很重要，因为它给我上学的能量。你早餐吃什么？
bodyTranslation.iba: Genap pagi, aku makai bubur lalu ngirup susu sigelas. Aku mega rinduka makai utai sayur laban iya bemakai manah ke tubuh. Pengabang pagi beguna laban iya meri kuasa ke aku ngagai sekula. Nama pemakai nuan?

meaning.en: a two-wheeled vehicle you pedal
a hard hat worn to protect your head
the path beside a road for walking
a place where a bus stops to pick up passengers
coloured lights that control traffic
to put a helmet on for safety
to stand at the bus stop for a bus
to walk on the path beside the road

sentences.text: I always wear a helmet when I ride my bicycle.

translation.ms: Saya sentiasa memakai topi keledar semasa menunggang basikal.
translation.zh: 我骑自行车时总是戴头盔。
translation.iba: Aku seruran makai topi keledar maya nunggang basikal.

sentences.text: We waited at the bus stop for ten minutes.

translation.ms: Kami menunggu di perhentian bas selama sepuluh minit.
translation.zh: 我们在公交车站等了十分钟。
translation.iba: Kami nganti di penenti bas lama sepuluh minit.

task035.scenario: Your friend is visiting your town for the first time and asked how to get around safely. Write an email to your friend about transport in your town.
bullets: how to stay safe near roads
where the nearest bus stop is

modelAnswer.subject: Getting Around My Town
modelAnswer.body: I usually ride my bicycle to school and wear a helmet. When I walk, I stay on the pavement and cross at the traffic light. The bus stop is near the market.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya biasanya menunggang basikal ke sekolah dan memakai topi keledar. Apabila saya berjalan kaki, saya berada di kaki lima dan menyeberang di lampu isyarat. Perhentian bas berhampiran pasar.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我通常骑自行车上学，并且戴上头盔。走路的时候，我会走在人行道上，并在红绿灯处过马路。公交车站在市场附近。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku selalu nunggang basikal ngagai sekula lalu makai helmet. Lebuh aku bejalai kaki, aku bejalai ba jalai pejalai kaki lalu nyeliak ba lampu isyarat. Perhenti bas semak pasar.

meaning.en: waste material that is thrown away
to throw rubbish on the ground
to put a seed or young tree into the ground
a container for rubbish
to make a place tidy by removing rubbish
to put rubbish into a bin
to put a young tree into the ground
to remove rubbish from a park

sentences.text: We cleaned up the park and threw rubbish in the bin.

translation.ms: Kami membersihkan taman dan membuang sampah dalam tong sampah.
translation.zh: 我们清理了公园，把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。
translation.iba: Kami ngamboh taman lalu muai sarak dalam tong sarak.

sentences.text: My class planted a tree behind the school.

translation.ms: Kelas saya menanam pokok di belakang sekolah.
translation.zh: 我们班在学校后面种了一棵树。
translation.iba: Kelas aku nanam kayu belakang sekula.

task036.scenario: Your class went on a school trip to clean up a park. Write an email to your friend about helping the environment.
bullets: what your class did to help
one thing pupils should not do

modelAnswer.subject: Cleaning Up the Park
modelAnswer.body: Last Saturday, my class went to the park to clean up rubbish. We picked up litter and threw it into the bin. We also planted a small tree. I felt proud to help the environment.

bodyTranslation.ms: Sabtu lepas, kelas saya pergi ke taman untuk membersihkan sampah. Kami mengutip sampah dan membuangnya ke dalam tong sampah. Kami juga menanam sepohon pokok kecil. Saya berasa bangga dapat membantu alam sekitar.
bodyTranslation.zh: 上星期六，我班同学去公园清理垃圾。我们捡起垃圾并把它们扔进垃圾桶。我们还种了一棵小树。能为环境出一份力，我感到很自豪。
bodyTranslation.iba: Sabtu ke udah, kelas aku mansang ngagai taman ngambika muai sampah. Kami ngambi sampah lalu muai ba tong sampah. Kami mega nanam kayu mit siti. Aku rasa berai ulih nulung dunya tu.

meaning.en: a large wild cat known as the king of animals
a large wild cat with orange and black stripes
a person who takes care of animals at a zoo
a fenced area where zoo animals live
to make a loud, deep sound like a lion
to go and see animals at the zoo
to give food to animals
to listen to a lion roaring

sentences.text: We visited the zoo and heard the lion roar loudly.

translation.ms: Kami melawat zoo dan mendengar singa meraung dengan kuat.
translation.zh: 我们参观了动物园，听到狮子大声咆哮。
translation.iba: Kami nemuai zoo lalu ninga singa beraung enggau ringkak.

sentences.text: The zookeeper let us feed the animals in the enclosure.

translation.ms: Penjaga zoo membenarkan kami memberi makan haiwan di dalam kandang.
translation.zh: 动物园管理员让我们在围栏里喂动物。
translation.iba: Pengiring zoo ngasuh kami ngemakai jelu dalam kandang.

task037.scenario: Your family visited the zoo last weekend. Write an email to your cousin about an animal you saw at the zoo.
bullets: how the animal made a sound or moved

modelAnswer.subject: Our Zoo Trip
modelAnswer.body: Last weekend, my family visited the zoo. I saw a tiger resting in its enclosure and heard a lion roar loudly. The zookeeper told us tigers can swim very well. It was an amazing trip!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hujung minggu lepas, keluarga saya melawat zoo. Saya nampak seekor harimau berehat dalam kandangnya dan mendengar singa mengaum dengan kuat. Penjaga zoo memberitahu kami harimau boleh berenang dengan sangat baik. Ia satu lawatan yang menakjubkan!
bodyTranslation.zh: 上周末，我和家人参观了动物园。我看见一只老虎在围栏里休息，还听到狮子大声吼叫。动物园管理员告诉我们老虎很会游泳。这真是一次奇妙的旅行！
bodyTranslation.iba: Hujung minggu ke udah, keluarga aku napang ngagai zoo. Aku meda seekur remaung betikai dalam kandang iya lalu ninga singa nyawa inggar. Tuai zoo madah ngagai kami remaung ulih nganang manah amat. Nya pengabang ti manah amat!

meaning.en: a game played by kicking a ball into a goal
a person who trains a sports team
a group of players who play together
a game played between two teams
to get a point in a game
to become a member of a sports club
to get a goal in football
to train together with a team

sentences.text: Our coach taught us how to score a goal.

translation.ms: Jurulatih kami mengajar kami cara menjaringkan gol.
translation.zh: 我们的教练教我们如何进球。
translation.iba: Pelatih kami ngajar kami chara nyaring gol.

sentences.text: I want to join the football team next term.

translation.ms: Saya mahu menyertai pasukan bola sepak semester depan.
translation.zh: 我下学期想加入足球队。
translation.iba: Aku deka nitihka pasukan bal peluru semester baru.

task038.scenario: Your school is starting a new sports club. Write an email to your friend inviting them to join a sports club with you.
bullets: which sports club you want to join
why your friend should join too

modelAnswer.subject: Join the Football Club!
modelAnswer.body: Our school is starting a football club this term. The coach trains the team every Wednesday afternoon. I want to join because I love playing football and scoring goals. Please join the club with me!

bodyTranslation.ms: Sekolah kami akan memulakan kelab bola sepak pada penggal ini. Jurulatih melatih pasukan setiap petang Rabu. Saya mahu menyertai kerana saya suka bermain bola sepak dan menjaringkan gol. Sila sertai kelab ini bersama saya!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我们学校这学期要成立一个足球俱乐部。教练每周三下午训练队伍。我想加入，因为我喜欢踢足球和进球。请和我一起加入这个俱乐部吧！
bodyTranslation.iba: Sekula kami deka ngemuka kelab bola sepak penggal tu. Cikgu ngajar pasukan genap kelemari hari Rabu. Aku deka nyagi laban aku rinduka main bola sepak enggau ngena gol. Nyagi meh enggau aku ba kelab tu!

meaning.en: a body temperature that is higher than normal
a sudden noisy release of air from the lungs
a pain in the head
a person trained to treat sick people
a place where sick people are treated
to visit a doctor for treatment
to feel hot with a high temperature
used to wish someone a fast recovery

sentences.text: My mother took me to see a doctor because I had a fever.

translation.ms: Ibu saya membawa saya berjumpa doktor kerana saya demam.
translation.zh: 我妈妈带我去看医生，因为我发烧了。
translation.iba: Indai aku mai aku betemu dukun laban aku angat pemedis.

sentences.text: I hope you get well soon and come back to school.

translation.ms: Saya harap awak cepat sembuh dan kembali ke sekolah.
translation.zh: 希望你早日康复，早点回学校。
translation.iba: Aku arap nuan gerai pengasi lalu pulai ngagai sekula.

task039.scenario: Your friend was absent from school. Write an email to your friend asking how they are feeling and wishing them well.
bullets: what you heard was wrong with them
what they should do to feel better

modelAnswer.subject: Get Well Soon
modelAnswer.body: I heard you have a fever and a bad cough. I hope you saw a doctor and are resting at home. Please drink lots of water and take your medicine. Get well soon!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya dengar awak demam dan batuk teruk. Saya harap awak sudah berjumpa doktor dan sedang berehat di rumah. Sila minum banyak air dan makan ubat awak. Semoga cepat sembuh!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我听说你发烧还咳嗽得很厉害。希望你已经看了医生，并在家休息。请多喝水，按时吃药。祝你早日康复！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku ninga nuan demam enggau batuk merinsa. Aku angka nuan udah betemu enggau dokta lalu ngasuh diri betikai di rumah. Ngirup meh ai mayuh lalu makai ubat nuan. Semoga gerai pagila!

meaning.en: the hobby of gathering items of one kind
a sport played with a racket and shuttlecock
to become a member of a group
an activity done regularly for enjoyment
a musical instrument with strings
to become a member of a club
to gather coins as a hobby
to study how to play the guitar

sentences.text: My friend enjoys collecting coins from different countries.

translation.ms: Kawan saya suka mengumpul syiling dari negara berlainan.
translation.zh: 我的朋友喜欢收集不同国家的硬币。
translation.iba: Kawan aku rinduka ngumpul duit ari menua ti bebeda.

sentences.text: I joined the badminton club at school last month.

translation.ms: Saya menyertai kelab badminton di sekolah bulan lepas.
translation.zh: 我上个月加入了学校的羽毛球俱乐部。
translation.iba: Aku nitihka kelab badminton di sekula bulan ti udah.

task040.scenario: Your new online penpal asked about hobbies popular in Malaysia. Write an email to your penpal about your hobby and a hobby your friend enjoys.
bullets: how you spend time on your hobby each week

modelAnswer.subject: Hobbies We Enjoy
modelAnswer.body: My hobby is collecting coins from different countries, which my grandfather started. My best friend enjoys playing badminton and joined the school club last month. I spend an hour every weekend sorting my coin collection. What is your hobby?

bodyTranslation.ms: Hobi saya ialah mengumpul duit syiling dari negara yang berbeza, yang telah dimulakan oleh datuk saya. Kawan baik saya suka bermain badminton dan menyertai kelab sekolah bulan lepas. Saya meluangkan sejam setiap hujung minggu menyusun koleksi syiling saya. Apakah hobi awak?
bodyTranslation.zh: 我的爱好是收集不同国家的硬币，这是我爷爷开始的。我最好的朋友喜欢打羽毛球，上个月加入了学校的俱乐部。我每个周末都花一个小时整理我的硬币收藏。你的爱好是什么？
bodyTranslation.iba: Kesuka aku nya ngumpul duit syiling ari mayuh menua, ti udah dimulaka aki aku. Pangan ti pemadu manah aku rinduka main badminton lalu nyagi kelab sekula bulan ke udah. Aku bebasa sejam genap hujung minggu nyusun kesuka duit syiling aku. Nama kesuka nuan?

meaning.en: a large building with many shops
a building where interesting old objects are shown
an outdoor place with equipment for children to play
a shop that sells books
an open public area in a town, often with shops around it
to buy things at a shopping mall
to have fun at a playground
to look around a bookshop

sentences.text: On weekends, my family shops at the new mall in town.

translation.ms: Pada hujung minggu, keluarga saya membeli-belah di pusat beli-belah baharu di bandar.
translation.zh: 周末，我家人在城里的新商场购物。
translation.iba: Maya hujung minggu, kaban aku bebeli di pusat bebeli baru di pekan.

sentences.text: There is a lovely playground next to the town square.

translation.ms: Terdapat taman permainan yang indah bersebelahan dataran bandar.
translation.zh: 小镇广场旁边有一个漂亮的游乐场。
translation.iba: Bisi taman main ti manah semak dataran pekan.

task041.scenario: Your penpal from another country wants to know about your hometown. Write an email to your penpal describing your favourite places in town.
bullets: two favourite places in your town

modelAnswer.subject: My Favourite Places
modelAnswer.body: My favourite places in town are the mall and the museum. At the mall, I browse the bookshop for new stories. The museum has interesting old objects to see. There is also a fun playground near the square. Visit soon!

bodyTranslation.ms: Tempat kegemaran saya di bandar ialah pusat membeli-belah dan muzium. Di pusat membeli-belah, saya melihat-lihat kedai buku untuk cerita baharu. Muzium mempunyai objek lama yang menarik untuk dilihat. Terdapat juga taman permainan yang menyeronokkan berhampiran dataran. Datanglah tidak lama lagi!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我在镇上最喜欢的地方是商场和博物馆。在商场里，我喜欢逛书店找新故事。博物馆里有很多有趣的旧物品可以看。广场附近还有一个好玩的游乐场。快来玩吧！
bodyTranslation.iba: Endur ti pemadu dikerinduka aku ba pekan nya pusat pemli enggau muzium. Ba pusat pemli, aku meda kedai buku ngambi leka cherita baru. Muzium bisi utai lama ti nyamai dipeda. Bisi mega taman main ti nyamai semak padang besai. Datai meh pagila!

meaning.en: a formal event held to celebrate something
a metal disc given as a prize for winning
to take part in a contest against others
to shout support for someone
a person who watches an event
to receive a medal for winning
to shout support for a team
to take part in a race

sentences.text: Hundreds of spectators cheered during the opening ceremony.

translation.ms: Beratus-ratus penonton bersorak semasa istiadat perasmian.
translation.zh: 数百名观众在开幕式上欢呼。
translation.iba: Beratus penonton nyorak maya upacara pemuka.

sentences.text: My sister competed in the race and won a medal.

translation.ms: Kakak saya bertanding dalam perlumbaan itu dan memenangi pingat.
translation.zh: 我姐姐参加了比赛并赢得了奖牌。
translation.iba: Menyadi indu aku betanding dalam perlumba lalu menang pingat.

task042.scenario: Your school held a sports day event. Write an email to your friend describing what happened.
bullets: what happened at the opening ceremony

modelAnswer.subject: Our Sports Day
modelAnswer.body: Our school held Sports Day last Friday with a colourful opening ceremony. Many spectators cheered loudly for every runner. My best friend competed in the relay race and won a silver medal. It was a very exciting day for everyone!

bodyTranslation.ms: Sekolah kami mengadakan Hari Sukan pada hari Jumaat lepas dengan majlis perasmian yang berwarna-warni. Ramai penonton bersorak dengan kuat untuk setiap pelari. Kawan baik saya bertanding dalam lumba lari berganti-ganti dan memenangi pingat perak. Ia satu hari yang sangat mengujakan untuk semua orang!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我们学校上周五举办了运动会，开幕仪式非常精彩多彩。许多观众为每一位跑步选手大声欢呼。我最好的朋友参加了接力赛，赢得了一枚银牌。那真是让大家都非常兴奋的一天！
bodyTranslation.iba: Sekula kami ngaga Hari Sukan Jumat ke udah enggau upacara pemuka ti macha-macha. Mayuh orang niki nyawa inggar ke genap orang balap. Pangan ti pemadu manah aku milu balap ganti-ganti lalu menang pingat pirak. Nya hari ti ngujaka amat ke semua orang!

meaning.en: an animal that hunts other animals for food
the natural home of a plant or animal
at risk of disappearing forever
a thick forest with heavy rainfall
colouring that helps an animal hide
to keep an animal's home safe
to blend in with the surroundings for safety
a type of animal at risk of disappearing

sentences.text: The tiger is a predator that lives in the rainforest.

translation.ms: Harimau ialah pemangsa yang hidup di hutan hujan.
translation.zh: 老虎是生活在雨林中的捕食者。
translation.iba: Remaung nya jelu ti mangsa ti diau dalam babas ujan.

sentences.text: Many endangered animals need their habitat to be protected.

translation.ms: Banyak haiwan terancam memerlukan habitat mereka dilindungi.
translation.zh: 许多濒危动物需要保护它们的栖息地。
translation.iba: Mayuh jelu ti meruan lenyap begunaka habitat sida dijaga.

task043.scenario: Your class watched a wildlife documentary. Write an email to your teacher about an animal you learned about.
bullets: why it needs to be protected

modelAnswer.subject: The Documentary We Watched
modelAnswer.body: Thank you for showing us the wildlife documentary. I learned that the tiger is a predator that lives in the rainforest and uses camouflage to hunt. Sadly, it is an endangered species. We should protect its habitat before it disappears.

bodyTranslation.ms: Terima kasih kerana menunjukkan kami dokumentari hidupan liar. Saya belajar bahawa harimau ialah pemangsa yang tinggal di hutan hujan dan menggunakan penyamaran untuk memburu. Malangnya, ia adalah spesies terancam. Kita patut melindungi habitatnya sebelum ia pupus.
bodyTranslation.zh: 谢谢你给我们放映野生动物纪录片。我了解到老虎是一种住在雨林里的掠食者，它用伪装来捕猎。可惜的是，它是濒危物种。我们应该在它消失之前保护它的栖息地。
bodyTranslation.iba: Terima kasih ke udah nunjukka kami dokumentari jelu babas. Aku belajar remaung nya jelu ke berburu ke diau dalam babas ujan lalu ngena penyamaran alai berburu. Sayangka, iya spesies ti deka lesap. Kitai patut nyaga endur diau iya sebedau iya lesap.

meaning.en: a gathering of the whole school for announcements
a chart showing when each lesson happens
a small cupboard for storing belongings
the head teacher of a school
a short break between lessons
to be present at a school assembly
to store books in a locker
to pay attention when the principal speaks

sentences.text: Every Monday, the principal speaks to us at assembly.

translation.ms: Setiap hari Isnin, pengetua bercakap dengan kami semasa perhimpunan.
translation.zh: 每个星期一，校长在集会上跟我们讲话。
translation.iba: Genap hari Isnin, pengetua bejaku ngagai kami maya pekumpul.

sentences.text: I keep my extra books safely in my locker.

translation.ms: Saya menyimpan buku tambahan saya dengan selamat dalam peti kunci.
translation.zh: 我把多余的书安全地放在储物柜里。
translation.iba: Aku nyimpan bup tambah aku enggau selamat dalam peti kunchi.

task044.scenario: Your penpal wants to know what a typical school day is like for you. Write an email to your penpal describing your school day.
bullets: one thing you like about your school

modelAnswer.subject: A Day at My School
modelAnswer.body: Every school day starts with an assembly where our principal makes announcements. I keep extra books in my locker. During recess, I play with friends in the field. I like my school because the teachers are kind!

bodyTranslation.ms: Setiap hari persekolahan bermula dengan perhimpunan tempat pengetua kami membuat pengumuman. Saya menyimpan buku tambahan dalam lokar saya. Semasa waktu rehat, saya bermain dengan kawan-kawan di padang. Saya suka sekolah saya kerana guru-gurunya baik hati!
bodyTranslation.zh: 每个上学日都以朝会开始，校长会在朝会上做各种通知。我把多余的书放在储物柜里。课间休息时，我和朋友们在操场上玩耍。我喜欢我的学校，因为老师们都很和善！
bodyTranslation.iba: Genap hari sekula berengkah enggau perhimpunan alai pengetua kami meri pengumuman. Aku ngintu buku bukai dalam lokar aku. Lebuh maya rehat, aku main enggau pangan ba padang. Aku rinduka sekula aku laban cikgu manah ati!

meaning.en: following old customs passed down over time
one of the foods used to make a dish
having a hot, strong taste
good for the body, full of nutrients
a set of instructions for cooking a dish
to prepare a dish following old customs
to cook using written instructions
a hot, strong flavour

sentences.text: My grandmother follows an old recipe to cook a traditional dish.

translation.ms: Nenek saya mengikut resepi lama untuk memasak hidangan tradisional.
translation.zh: 我奶奶按照古老的食谱做一道传统菜肴。
translation.iba: Aki aku nitihka resepi lama kena masak pangan tradisi.

sentences.text: The soup has a spicy taste but is very nutritious.

translation.ms: Sup itu berasa pedas tetapi sangat berkhasiat.
translation.zh: 这汤味道辣，但很有营养。
translation.iba: Sup nya rasa pedis tang beguna amat ke tubuh.

task045.scenario: Your friend asked about food from your culture. Write an email to your friend describing a traditional dish and why it is healthy.
bullets: what the traditional dish is called

modelAnswer.subject: A Traditional Dish
modelAnswer.body: My favourite traditional dish is a fish soup my grandmother cooks using an old family recipe. The ingredients include fresh fish, ginger, and vegetables, which make it nutritious. It has a spicy taste that I enjoy. You should try it!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hidangan tradisional kegemaran saya ialah sup ikan yang dimasak oleh nenek saya menggunakan resipi keluarga yang lama. Bahan-bahannya termasuk ikan segar, halia, dan sayur-sayuran, yang menjadikannya berkhasiat. Ia mempunyai rasa pedas yang saya suka. Awak patut mencubanya!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我最喜欢的传统菜肴是奶奶用祖传老配方煮的鱼汤。食材包括新鲜的鱼、姜和蔬菜，让它营养丰富。它带着我很喜欢的辣味。你应该试试看！
bodyTranslation.iba: Pemakai lama ti pemadu dikerinduka aku nya sup ikan ti dimasak Nenek aku ngena resipi keluarga lama. Bahan iya nyengkaum ikan baru, alia, enggau sayur, ke ngasuh iya bemakai manah. Iya rasa pedas ke aku rinduka. Nuan patut nyoba nya!

meaning.en: the player who stops the ball from entering the goal

a series of matches in a competition
practice to improve a skill

sentences.text: I attend training twice a week to prepare for the tournament.

translation.ms: Saya menghadiri latihan dua kali seminggu untuk bersedia menghadapi kejohanan.
translation.zh: 我每周训练两次，为锦标赛做准备。
translation.iba: Aku datai ke latihan dua kali seminggu kena besedia ke pertandingan.

sentences.text: The goalkeeper worked hard with the referee's fair decisions.

translation.ms: Penjaga gol berusaha keras dengan keputusan adil pengadil.
translation.zh: 守门员在裁判的公正判罚下努力表现。
translation.iba: Penjaga gol beguai ngena keputusan pengadil ti lurus.

task046.scenario: Your school is forming a new sports team for the inter-school competition. Write an email to your coach asking to join and explaining why.
bullets: which position you want to play
why you want to join the team
what training you have already done

modelAnswer.subject: Joining the Team
modelAnswer.body: I would like to join the school football team for the inter-school tournament. I want to be the goalkeeper because I am good at catching the ball. I have been training with my teammates every weekend. Please let me join!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya ingin menyertai pasukan bola sepak sekolah untuk kejohanan antara sekolah. Saya mahu menjadi penjaga gol kerana saya mahir menangkap bola. Saya telah berlatih dengan rakan sepasukan saya setiap hujung minggu. Sila benarkan saya menyertai!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我想加入学校足球队参加校际联赛。我想当守门员，因为我很擅长接球。我一直和队友每个周末一起训练。请让我加入吧！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku deka nyagi pasukan bola sepak sekula ke pertandingan antara sekula. Aku deka nyadi penjaga gol laban aku manah nangkap bola. Aku udah belatih enggau pangan sepasukan aku genap hujung minggu. Awakka aku nyagi!

meaning.en: showing no fear when facing danger or difficulty
putting a lot of effort and energy into work
to respect and think highly of someone
a person whose behaviour is worth copying
to encourage someone to do something well
to admire and respect someone
someone whose behaviour is worth copying
to put in a lot of effort daily

sentences.text: I admire my mother because she is brave and hardworking.

translation.ms: Saya mengagumi ibu saya kerana dia berani dan rajin.
translation.zh: 我敬佩我的妈妈，因为她既勇敢又勤奋。
translation.iba: Aku ngasuh kasih indai aku laban iya berani sereta rajin.

sentences.text: My teacher inspires me to work hard every day.

translation.ms: Guru saya memberi inspirasi kepada saya untuk bekerja keras setiap hari.
translation.zh: 我的老师激励我每天努力学习。
translation.iba: Guru aku meri semangat ke aku beguai genap hari.

task047.scenario: A magazine is collecting pupils' stories about someone they admire. Write an email to the magazine about a person who inspires you.

modelAnswer.subject: Someone I Admire
modelAnswer.body: I admire my grandmother because she is brave and hardworking. She raised five children by herself and never complained. She is my role model because she always tries her best. She inspires me to work hard every day at school.

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya mengagumi nenek saya kerana beliau berani dan rajin. Beliau membesarkan lima orang anak sendirian dan tidak pernah mengeluh. Beliau adalah suri teladan saya kerana beliau sentiasa berusaha sedaya upaya. Beliau memberi inspirasi kepada saya untuk berusaha bersungguh-sungguh setiap hari di sekolah.
bodyTranslation.zh: 我敬佩我的奶奶，因为她既勇敢又勤劳。她独自抚养五个孩子长大，从不抱怨。她是我的榜样，因为她总是尽自己最大的努力。她激励我每天在学校都努力学习。
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku ngasi Nenek aku laban iya berani lalu rajin. Iya ngibunka lima iku anak enggi diri lalu nadai suah bekungkuk. Iya jadi teladan aku laban iya seruran beguna amat. Iya ngasuh aku beguna amat genap hari ba sekula.

meaning.en: a case used for carrying clothes when travelling
an official document needed to travel to another country
an item bought to remember a trip
a journey made by aeroplane
an area of sand next to the sea
to put clothes into a suitcase for travel
to purchase an item to remember a trip
to board a plane in time for travel

sentences.text: I packed my suitcase carefully before catching the flight.

translation.ms: Saya mengemas beg pakaian dengan teliti sebelum menaiki penerbangan.
translation.zh: 我在赶航班前仔细打包了行李箱。
translation.iba: Aku ngemas beg pakaian enggau tesat sebedau nepan penerbangan.

sentences.text: We bought a small souvenir from the shop near the beach.

translation.ms: Kami membeli cenderamata kecil dari kedai berhampiran pantai.
translation.zh: 我们在海滩附近的商店买了一个小纪念品。
translation.iba: Kami meli cenderamata mit ari kedai semak pasir.

task048.scenario: Your friend is planning their first holiday abroad. Write an email to your friend with tips based on your last holiday.
bullets: what to pack in the suitcase

modelAnswer.subject: Holiday Tips
modelAnswer.body: I am excited for your first holiday abroad! Remember to pack your suitcase with light clothes and never forget your passport before the flight. When you visit the beach, buy a small souvenir to remember the trip. Have a holiday!

bodyTranslation.ms: Saya teruja untuk percutian pertama awak ke luar negara! Ingat untuk mengemas beg pakaian dengan pakaian yang ringan dan jangan sekali-kali lupa pasport awak sebelum penerbangan. Apabila awak melawat pantai, beli cenderahati kecil untuk mengingati perjalanan itu. Selamat bercuti!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我为你第一次出国度假感到兴奋！记得在行李箱里装上轻便的衣物，登机前千万别忘了带护照。去海滩玩的时候，买一份小纪念品来记住这次旅行。祝你假期愉快！
bodyTranslation.iba: Aku gaga amat ke pengalih malam pertama nuan ngagai luar menua! Ingat ngemas beg pakaian enggau pakaian ti lampai lalu nadai suah lupa pasport nuan sebedau terbai. Lebuh nuan napang ngagai pasir, beli cenderamata mit ngambika ingat pengabang nya. Selamat bekelala!

meaning.en: a practice of what to do if there is a fire
a loud sound warning of danger
to leave a dangerous place quickly and safely
equipment used to put out a fire
a way out of a building
to set off an alarm to warn people
to leave a building quickly for safety
to leave through the closest exit

sentences.text: When the alarm sounded, we evacuated the building calmly.

translation.ms: Apabila penggera berbunyi, kami mengosongkan bangunan dengan tenang.
translation.zh: 警报响起时，我们冷静地疏散了大楼。
translation.iba: Lebuh penggera nyala, kami ngosongka bangunan enggau tenang.

sentences.text: The teacher showed us where the fire extinguisher and exit were.

translation.ms: Guru menunjukkan kepada kami tempat alat pemadam api dan pintu keluar.
translation.zh: 老师给我们展示了灭火器和出口的位置。
translation.iba: Guru nunjuk ka kami endur alat pemadam api enggau pintu pansut.

task049.scenario: Your school held a fire drill. Write an email to your penpal describing what happened and what you learned about emergency safety.
bullets: what happened when the alarm sounded
what you learned about staying safe

modelAnswer.subject: Our Fire Drill
modelAnswer.body: This morning, our school held a fire drill. When the alarm sounded loudly, all the pupils stopped their work and calmly evacuated the building through the nearest exit. Our teacher showed us the fire extinguishers earlier. I learned that staying calm and walking quickly keeps everyone safe during an emergency.

bodyTranslation.ms: Pagi ini, sekolah kami mengadakan latihan kebakaran. Apabila penggera berbunyi kuat, semua murid berhenti daripada kerja mereka dan keluar bangunan dengan tenang melalui pintu keluar terdekat. Guru kami menunjukkan alat pemadam api kepada kami sebelum itu. Saya belajar bahawa kekal tenang dan berjalan pantas menjaga keselamatan semua orang semasa kecemasan.
bodyTranslation.zh: 今天早上，我们学校进行了消防演习。当警报器大声响起时，所有同学都停下手中的工作，冷静地从最近的出口撤离教学楼。我们的老师之前给我们展示过灭火器。我学到了保持冷静并快速行走能让每个人在紧急情况下保持安全。
bodyTranslation.iba: Pagi tu, sekula kami ngaga latihan api. Lebuh alarm nyawa inggar, semua pelajar badu pengawa sida lalu pansa dari rumah enggau tenang nengah pintu ti semak amat. Cikgu kami nunjukka kami alat pemadam api dulu. Aku belajar tetap tenang enggau bejalai enggat nyaga semua orang selamat maya kecemasan.

meaning.en: a group of people born around the same time
a custom passed down from earlier generations
something new created for the first time
something remembered from the past
a time in the past
referring to a time long ago
to give a custom to the next generation
to tell someone about something you remember

sentences.text: My grandfather shared a memory about life in the old days.

translation.ms: Datuk saya berkongsi kenangan tentang kehidupan pada zaman dahulu.
translation.zh: 我爷爷分享了他对过去生活的回忆。
translation.iba: Aki aku bebagi kenangan pasal pengidup ba jaman dulu.

sentences.text: Every generation should pass down important family traditions.

translation.ms: Setiap generasi patut mewarisi tradisi keluarga yang penting.
translation.zh: 每一代人都应该传承重要的家庭传统。
translation.iba: Genap generasi patut ngasuh adat kaban ti beguna ari nenek.

task050.scenario: Your grandfather told you a story about life when he was young. Write an email to your friend about what you learned about the past.
bullets: how life was different in the old days
why traditions are important to pass down

modelAnswer.subject: Stories From the Past
modelAnswer.body: Yesterday, my grandfather shared a memory about his childhood in the old days. He told me his generation had no phones or televisions, so children played outside and told stories. I learned many inventions we use today did not exist. I understand why traditions should pass to the next generation.

bodyTranslation.ms: Semalam, datuk saya berkongsi kenangan tentang zaman kanak-kanaknya dahulu. Dia memberitahu saya generasinya tidak mempunyai telefon atau televisyen, jadi kanak-kanak bermain di luar dan bercerita. Saya belajar bahawa banyak ciptaan yang kita gunakan hari ini tidak wujud pada masa itu. Saya faham mengapa tradisi patut diwariskan kepada generasi seterusnya.
bodyTranslation.zh: 昨天，爷爷和我分享了他童年时代的一段回忆。他告诉我，他们那一代没有电话也没有电视，所以孩子们都在外面玩耍、讲故事。我了解到我们今天使用的很多发明当年都还不存在。我明白了为什么传统应该传给下一代。
bodyTranslation.iba: Kemari, Aki aku bekaul ingatan pasal maya iya biak dulu. Iya madah ngagai aku generasi iya nadai telefon tauka televisyen, nya alai anak biak main di luar lalu bejaku cherita. Aku belajar mayuh temuan ke kitai ngena tu hari nadai maya nya. Aku ngeretika kebuah tradisi patut nurun ngagai generasi bukai.

meaning.en: a long, difficult walk, especially through hills or forest
water falling from a high place
to travel through a place to learn about it
a bag carried on the back for travel
a path through the countryside or forest
to travel a long, difficult walk
to walk along a marked path
to fill a backpack for a trip

sentences.text: We packed our backpacks before starting the jungle trek.

translation.ms: Kami mengemas beg galas sebelum memulakan kembara hutan.
translation.zh: 我们在开始丛林徒步前打包了背包。
translation.iba: Kami ngemas beg galas sebedau berengkah bejalai jauh dalam babas.

sentences.text: The trail led us to a beautiful hidden waterfall.

translation.ms: Denai itu membawa kami ke air terjun tersembunyi yang cantik.
translation.zh: 小径把我们带到一个美丽的隐藏瀑布。
translation.iba: Jalai nya mai kami ngagai wong ai ti tersembuni sereta manah.

task051.scenario: Your family went on a jungle trekking adventure. Write an email to your cousin about the adventure.
bullets: how you prepared for the trek
what you discovered along the trail
how you felt during the adventure

modelAnswer.subject: Our Jungle Adventure
modelAnswer.body: Last weekend, my family packed our backpacks and went on an exciting jungle trek. We followed a narrow trail through the forest and explored areas we had never seen. After two hours of walking, we reached a hidden waterfall. I felt proud and tired, but it was a great adventure!

bodyTranslation.ms: Hujung minggu lepas, keluarga saya mengemas beg galas kami dan pergi mengembara di hutan yang mengujakan. Kami mengikuti denai sempit melalui hutan dan meneroka kawasan yang tidak pernah kami lihat sebelum ini. Selepas dua jam berjalan, kami sampai ke air terjun tersembunyi. Saya berasa bangga dan penat, tetapi ia satu pengembaraan yang hebat!
bodyTranslation.zh: 上周末，我们一家人收拾好背包，去丛林探险，非常刺激。我们沿着森林里一条狭窄的小径前进，探索我们从未见过的地方。走了两个小时后，我们到达了一个隐藏的瀑布。我感到既自豪又疲惫，但这真是一次很棒的探险！
bodyTranslation.iba: Hujung minggu ke udah, keluarga aku ngemas beg galas kami lalu mansang ngundan babas ti ngujaka. Kami nitihka jalai mit nengah babas lalu ngundan endur ke apin pernah kami peda. Udah dua jam bejalai, kami datai ngagai ai terejun ke sesok. Aku berai lalu lelak, tang nya pengabang ti manah amat!

meaning.en: a person who designs and builds machines or structures
a person who flies an aeroplane
the place where a person works
an ability to do something well
the job a person does for most of their life
to decide on a job to do for life
to improve at doing something
to go and see where someone works

sentences.text: The engineer explained her job when we visited her workplace.

translation.ms: Jurutera itu menerangkan kerjanya semasa kami melawat tempat kerjanya.
translation.zh: 工程师在我们参观她的工作场所时讲解了她的工作。
translation.iba: Jurutera nya nerangka kereja iya maya kami nemuai endur kereja iya.

sentences.text: Every pilot needs strong skills and years of training.

translation.ms: Setiap juruterbang memerlukan kemahiran yang kukuh dan latihan bertahun-tahun.
translation.zh: 每位飞行员都需要扎实的技能和多年的训练。
translation.iba: Genap jurutebai begunaka kemahiran ti kering sereta latihan betaun-taun.

task052.scenario: Your school held a Career Day with visiting speakers. Write an email to your friend about a job you found interesting.
bullets: which career speaker you listened to
why you found the job interesting

modelAnswer.subject: Career Day at School
modelAnswer.body: Our school held Career Day yesterday, and I listened to an engineer talk about her workplace. She explained that engineers need strong maths skills and years of training. I spoke with a pilot who flies to many countries. I found the engineer's job most interesting because I enjoy building things!

bodyTranslation.ms: Sekolah kami mengadakan Hari Kerjaya semalam, dan saya mendengar seorang jurutera bercakap tentang tempat kerjanya. Dia menerangkan bahawa jurutera memerlukan kemahiran matematik yang kukuh dan latihan bertahun-tahun. Saya bercakap dengan seorang juruterbang yang terbang ke banyak negara. Saya rasa kerja jurutera paling menarik kerana saya suka membina benda!
bodyTranslation.zh: 我们学校昨天举办了职业日活动，我听一位工程师讲述她工作场所的情况。她解释说工程师需要扎实的数学能力和多年的培训。我还和一位飞往许多国家的飞行员交谈过。我觉得工程师的工作最有趣，因为我喜欢建造东西！
bodyTranslation.iba: Sekula kami ngaga Hari Pengawa kemari, lalu aku ninga siti jurutera bejaku pasal endur pengawa iya. Iya nerangka jurutera perlu pandai matematik ti kering enggau latihan taun mayuh. Aku bejaku enggau siti juruterbang ke terbai ngagai mayuh menua. Aku rasa pengawa jurutera pemadu nyamai laban aku rinduka ngaga utai!

meaning.en: the raised area at a train station where passengers wait
the money paid to travel on public transport
a person who regularly travels to work or school
